item.title: 1967 Mercedes-Benz 250SE Coupe
item.description: This 1967 Mercedes-Benz 250SE coupe is one of approximately 5,260 examples produced between 1965 and 1967. The car is powered by a 2.5-liter inline-six paired with a four-speed automatic transmission and is finished in Tobacco Brown over beige leather. Equipment includes a sunroof, 14″ steel wheels with covers, disc brakes, power steering, lap seatbelts, a Becker Grand Prix radio, and air conditioning. item.title: Single-Family-Owned 1980 Porsche 911SC Coupe Weissach
item.description: This 1980 Porsche 911SC is one of approximately 400 Weissach Coupes produced, and it was purchased new by the current owner's uncle via California Porsche-Audi in San Francisco. Ownership passed to the seller circa 2008, and the car now shows 120k miles. item.title: LS3-Powered 1969 Chevrolet Camaro Coupe 6-Speed
item.description: This 1969 Chevrolet Camaro coupe was found in a barn in Ohio per the seller, who acquired it in 2013. item.title: 1973 Pontiac Firebird Trans Am SD-455
item.description: This 1973 Pontiac Firebird Trans Am is one of 252 SD-455 examples produced for the model year, and it was acquired by the selling dealer after it was listed on BaT in April 2025. It is finished in Buccaneer Red over white vinyl and is powered by a Super Duty 455ci V8 paired with a three-speed automatic transmission. item.title: This Week’s Weird and Wonderful—December 5, 2025

item.title: Japanese-Market 1998 Ferrari 456M GT 6-Speed
item.description: This 1998 Ferrari 456M GT is a left-hand-drive example that was delivered new to Cornes & Company, Limited in Tokyo, Japan, and now shows 4,500 kilometers (2,800 miles). It is said to have remained in the care of its original owner and their family until being acquired by the selling dealer in 2025 and imported to the US. item.title: 1953 Mercedes-Benz 220 Cabriolet A Art Car by Hiro Yamagata
item.description: This 1954 Mercedes-Benz 220 is one of 1,278 Cabriolet A models bodied by Sindelfingen Karosserie between 1951 and 1955. Chassis 9297752 was selected for use in Hiro Yamagata’s “Earthly Paradise” exhibit and was refurbished in 1996 prior to being hand-painted by the artist in Tropical Forest Green with a butterfly motif. item.title: 1987 Aston Martin V8 Volante Series 2
item.description: This 1987 Aston Martin V8 Volante Series 2 is finished in Royal Cherry over Natural leather and is powered by a 5.3-liter V8 linked with a five-speed manual transmission. Equipment includes a Powr-Lok limited-slip differential, a tan Everflex convertible top, 15" BBS Mahle wheels, independent front suspension, four-wheel ventilated disc brakes, grille-mounted driving lights, power windows, and an AM/FM stereo. item.title: 20k-Kilometer Euro 1997 Ferrari 550 Maranello
item.description: This 1997 Ferrari 550 Maranello is a European-market example that spent time in Germany, was imported to the US in 2024, and was recently acquired by the selling dealer. Finished in Nero Carbonio Metallic over Nero leather upholstery, the car is powered by a 5.5-liter V12 paired with a six-speed manual transaxle. Equipment includes a limited-slip differential, 18" five-spoke alloy wheels, fog lights, power-adjustable seats, a gated shifter, a Sony cassette stereo, and automatic climate control.
